name: media_control
description:
Control playback across all active desktop media apps (Spotify, Feishin, VLC, Chromium, Firefox, Blanket, KDE Connect).
    action: 'play', 'pause', 'play-pause', 'next', 'previous', 'stop', 'status', 'metadata', 'list-players'.
    player: optional player name (e.g. 'spotify', 'feishin', 'vlc', 'chromium'). Leave empty to control active player.
